company.name: Farther
company.shortDescription: Farther is an intelligent wealth platform that enhances wealth management for clients throughout their financial lives.
company.description: Farther is a wealth management company that combines financial advisory services with a proprietary technology platform designed to support investment management, financial planning, and tax optimization. The company provides clients with a centralized system for viewing and managing financial accounts, documents, portfolios, and cash management activities in one place. Farther offers services that include portfolio management, retirement planning, estate planning, business planning, and access to private market investment opportunities through its advisory and asset management teams. Its platform is designed to help advisors automate administrative processes, improve operational efficiency, and deliver customized investment strategies supported by data and analytics. The company also works with high-net-worth individuals, families, entrepreneurs, and institutions by providing integrated financial planning and investment management services tailored to varying levels of financial complexity.
